notes.title: Update report 2019-10-12
notes.notes:
Update items:

* Added to clear the display stand for merchandise.
When you choose to place the merchandise on the display stand,
Use the middle mouse button to click to set the small box of the product.
You can clear the placed items.

* Repair plus money and super chef secrets can be normal
(The secret technique is the same as the Bakery)

* Player returns Special Products 12 Achievements cannot be achieved,
But after checking, it is confirmed to be normal.
(The product is a tea egg,
This achievement can be obtained after the development is completed)

Thank you for your return.

notes.title: Classic old game - "Fantasy Convenience Store" is listed
notes.notes:
The classic old game "Dream Convenience Store" developed by Taiwan was officially launched on the Steam platform today (3) and launched a one-week listing sale. Don't miss out on players who like old stand-alone games.

     "Fantasy Convenience Store" is a business simulation game based on a convenient store. The original version was released in 2005. On the ontology, the "Dream Cake House" game engine,

        This Steam version, in addition to the game content of the year, has greatly modified the appearance of the game interface, and increased the game resolution up to 1280*960. In order to respond to the Steam platform, a wealth of achievements system, card items, and English language versions have also been added.

        Let us invite all the players who like the story and the stand-alone game like us to relive the touch of the game that year, and the "Fantasy Convenience Store" will once again spend the night with you laughing and tears.

notes.title: The listing date is postponed to October 2
notes.notes:
I am very sorry,

Due to the return of the review, the convenience store could not be listed on September 27th as expected.
The reason is just because the cloud archive settings are wrong...

This is our mistake, apologize to the players.

At present, we have resubmitted and applied to amend the listing date to October 2.
This is the time for the system to choose the fastest time to market.

And we will use this time to add more achievements to the game.
And add more incentives for the novice and graphic teaching system

Thank you for your expectation of the convenience store.
